name: Karur Vysya Bank Ltd
title: Karur Vysya Bank Ltd - 590003 - Transcript of Conference Call

read.thesis: Stable, high-ROA retail/gold-led bank: NIM held at 4.26%, credit cost 0.43% and ROA 2.1%, but management flagged funding-cost and repricing pressure ahead and guided advances growth of 18-20% for FY27.

utilisation.quote: Our working capital utilization for the last 1, 1.5 years is in the range of 76% to 79%. It is not going up, same level it is there.

triggers.label: Competitive pricing pressure in corporate/mortgage
triggers.quote: we expect huge competition in pricing from few banks, and it may bring down the yield going forward
triggers.highlight: huge competition in pricing from few banks

triggers.label: NIM guided above 4% for FY27
triggers.quote: NIM for the full year will be in the range of 4% plus.
triggers.highlight: NIM for the full year will be in the range of 4% plus

triggers.label: Mortgage repricing by rivals
triggers.quote: some sort of poaching is happening few banks, they are offering a lower rate and they are giving it

guidance.quote: our guidance for credit growth would be between 18% to 20% for the financial year '26-'27
NIM for the full year will be in the range of 4% plus.
ROA for the full year will be about 2%.
Our GNPA expected to be less than 1.5% and NNPA will be less than 1%
we feel that we will be below 45% in the next 2 quarters to come.
We have planned for opening 50 branches during the current financial year

prior_guidance_check.quote: I am pleased to report that we were able to maintain our net interest margin at 4.26% for this quarter also.
Gross slippages for the quarter amounted to INR123 crores, representing 0.44% annualized

red_flags.label: Gold loan yield/price competition from lower-rate lenders
red_flags.quote: a few of the banks out of their anxiety, they need to grow. So they are giving a higher LTV, lower rate

red_flags.label: Non-core income dependence (recoveries, treasury)
red_flags.quote: overall, the write-off recovery for this quarter is 0.21

red_flags.label: Bancassurance commission at risk under IRDA framework
red_flags.quote: maybe 60%, 70% also can come down in a few cases

evasions.quote: I cannot say competitive pressure is not that much. Pressure is there.
are we in such a luxurious and comfortable position to think of '28 now?
